summary: Added the Plane test SSO user to the Keycloak group required by the shared oauth2-proxy edge gate.

problem.symptom: After a successful Keycloak login, the oauth2-proxy callback returned 403 Forbidden for tasks.0mcp.com.
problem.root_cause: The running oauth2-proxy configuration allows only the /0mcp-platform-admins group, while the temporary test user initially had only platform-read and grafana-viewers access.

changes: Added plane-test@0mcp.com to Keycloak group /0mcp-platform-admins in realm 0mcp.
Left the Plane local test account unchanged.

verification.result: The realm token endpoint still accepts the plane-test password and returns access and refresh tokens.

sensitive_material: The temporary password was returned only to the operator in chat and is intentionally not recorded in this receipt.
